scoring_justification: T1 recompute: checker recomputes overall site accuracy, compound-level accuracy, and per-element accuracies from prediction CSVs and scores against paper-reported values with monotonic thresholds.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold overall site accuracy and per-element accuracies for OS-ICSD and oxide test sets, derived from paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper Section Results and Discussion, Table 1, Fig 2
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted from paper text and figures

schema.description: Each row is an atom site from the OS-ICSD test set. composition is the material formula, element is the element symbol, true_oxidation_state is the ICSD-provided oxidation state, predicted_oxidation_state is the model output.

outputs.description: Per‑atom site predictions used to recompute overall site accuracy, compound-level accuracy, and per-element accuracies for the OS-ICSD test set.
Agent‑computed summary metrics for the OS-ICSD evaluation. Checked for structural completeness and plausible ranges.

schema.description: Each row is an atom site from the OS-ICSD-oxide test set.

outputs.description: Per‑atom site predictions used to recompute overall site accuracy, compound-level accuracy, and per-element accuracies for the oxide test set.
Agent‑computed summary metrics for the oxide evaluation. Checked for structural completeness and plausible ranges.

output_contract.notes: The checker recomputes site‑level, compound‑level, and per‑element accuracies directly from the prediction CSV files. The metrics JSON files are expected but serve as a structural sanity check; primary scoring relies on the recomputed values from the raw predictions.

steps.description: Recompute site accuracy and score against paper gold 96.82% with threshold_or_better.

Structural audit: required keys present, values in [0,100], per_element dict non-empty.
